description.text: Mirage's Mew, a starter deck released on 30 June 2005 alongside the Mirage Forest expansion, whose theme was the mythical Pokémon Mew. Its holo Mew card and its Mew coin set it apart, and its Pokémon-ex is Banette ex. It is a ready-built 30-card half deck with a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and markers, and a rule book, so two players could each buy one and play straight away.
